title: CROSS-MODALITY DEBIASING: USING LANGUAGE TO MITIGATE SUB-POPULATION SHIFTS IN IMAGING

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating average and worst-case classification accuracy on the CelebA dataset across sub-populations defined by gender-related attributes (e.g., male, female, man, woman, boy, girl).
Evaluating average and worst-case classification accuracy on the CelebA dataset across sub-populations defined by age-related attributes (e.g., old, young, adult, juvenile, mature, immature).
Evaluating average and worst-case classification accuracy on the Waterbirds dataset across sub-populations defined by image background settings (water vs. land backgrounds).

Evaluating average and worst-case classification accuracy on the CelebA dataset across sub-populations defined by specific physical traits (e.g., attractive vs. not attractive, straight hair vs. wavy hair).
